import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int n;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, it;

        Dinic(int n_) {
            n = n_;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            it = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int u, int c) {
            Edge a = new Edge(u, g.get(u).size(), c);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), 0);
            g.get(v).add(a);
            g.get(u).add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(v)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (int i = it[v]; i < g.get(v).size(); i++) {
                it[v] = i;
                Edge e = g.get(v).get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] + 1 == level[e.to]) {
                    int pushed = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.cap -= pushed;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            final int INF = 1 << 30;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(it, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfs(s, t, INF);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static Dinic dinic;
    static int n, t;
    static int S, T;
    static int rp, cp;
    static int in;
    static int[][] srcId = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] sinkId = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] mark = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] dist = new int[21][21];
    static char[][] grid = new char[21][21];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[21][21];
    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < n && c >= 0 && c < n;
    }

    static void searchEdges(int a, int b) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mark[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') mark[i][j] = 1;

        q.add(new int[]{rp, cp});
        q.add(new int[]{a, b});
        dist[a][b] = dist[rp][cp] = 0;
        mark[a][b] = 1;
        mark[rp][cp] = 2;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] now = q.poll();
            int r = now[0], c = now[1];
            if (mark[r][c] == 1 && grid2[r][c] > '0' && grid2[r][c] <= '9')
                dinic.addEdge(srcId[a][b], sinkId[r][c], 9);

            if (mark[r][c] == 1 && dist[r][c] == t) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                if (valid(nr, nc) && mark[nr][nc] == 0) {
                    mark[nr][nc] = mark[r][c];
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                } else if (mark[r][c] == 1 && valid(nr, nc) && mark[nr][nc] == 2 && dist[nr][nc] == dist[r][c] + 1 && grid2[nr][nc] > '0' && grid2[nr][nc] <= '9') {
                    dinic.addEdge(srcId[a][b], sinkId[nr][nc], 9);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        S = 202;
        T = 203;
        in = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(srcId[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(sinkId[i], -1);
        }

        dinic = new Dinic(300);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dinic.addEdge(S, in, grid[i][j] - '0');
                    srcId[i][j] = in++;
                }
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rp = i;
                    cp = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid2[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dinic.addEdge(in, T, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                    sinkId[i][j] = in++;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9' && grid2[i][j] > '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9')
                    dinic.addEdge(srcId[i][j], sinkId[i][j], 9);
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9')
                    searchEdges(i, j);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
